ideas.pitch: An AI-powered corporate strategy dashboard that evaluates Build vs. Buy vs. Partner decisions using real-time market data, financial forecasting, and regulatory compliance checks.
ideas.problem_statement: Evaluate Strategic Expansion & Conduct Deep Financial & Synergies Analysis for market leaders facing industry transformation.
ideas.title: StratSim AI: Corporate Expansion & M&A Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the C-suite corporate strategist case challenge by combining automated financial ROI modeling with risk assessment, echoing the predictive analytics success seen in winning forecasting hacks.

ideas.pitch: A strategic planning tool that calculates the financial viability and carbon credit offsets of integrating government PLI (Production Linked Incentive) schemes into industrial manufacturing roadmaps.
ideas.problem_statement: Assess Risks & Regulatory Landscape and Integrate ESG & Sustainability into long-term corporate growth strategies.
ideas.title: NetZeroCap: ESG & PLI Scheme Optimization Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a strategy sprint value deep policy and regulatory awareness; this tool quantifies complex government incentives and Net Zero commitments into a concrete 3-5 year financial roadmap.

ideas.pitch: An interactive supply chain stress-testing platform that models technological obsolescence and evaluates the cost-benefit of backward integration versus external sourcing.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve High-Stakes Business Case Studies by mapping out supply chain vulnerabilities and technological disruptions.
ideas.title: SupplyChainShield: Vulnerability & Backward Integration Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a live, interactive simulator that lets judges adjust macroeconomic parameters on the fly, ensuring a high-impact, working demo rather than static slides.

ideas.pitch: A specialized multi-agent workflow that ingests raw market research and outputs a fully structured, quantitatively backed executive pitch deck with financial synergies and implementation timelines.
ideas.problem_statement: Deliver an Actionable Executive Plan by packaging strategic recommendations and quantitative backing into an executive pitch deck.
ideas.title: ExecDeck AI: Automated C-Suite Strategy & Pitch Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core deliverable of the hackathon—the executive pitch deck—by accelerating the translation of complex case analysis into polished presentation outputs.

ideas.pitch: A specialized financial valuation tool designed for corporate strategists to compute post-merger integration costs, expected ROI, and margin improvements under various market scenarios.
ideas.problem_statement: Conduct Deep Financial & Synergies Analysis: Perform cost-benefit evaluations, model expected ROI, and justify capital allocations.
ideas.title: SynergyVal: M&A Synergy & ROI Modeler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers the rigorous quantitative backing and data-driven financial metrics that business case judges expect from top-tier corporate strategists.
